description: This file defines constants, macros, and function prototypes for Encrypted Advertising Data (EAD) in Bluetooth, including encryption and decryption functions.

methods.name: bt_ead_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts and authenticates advertising data using a session key and IV, producing encrypted payload with MIC.

methods.name: bt_ead_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts and authenticates encrypted advertising data using a session key and IV, retrieving original payload.
